# Richard Feng Creative

Richard Feng Creative is a Houston-based AI video advertising studio serving businesses across the United States. It is led by Richard Feng, also known as 小疯未眠 and Mr.Feng No Sleep.

## Core service

- AI commercial video production
- Short-form video advertising
- Creative direction and scripting
- AI visual production and editing
- Vertical social video for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube Shorts and Xiaohongshu
- Nationwide remote production for clients across the United States
- English and Chinese bilingual video campaigns
- Chinese-language service pages for Chinese-speaking business owners in the United States

## Industries represented in the portfolio

- Real estate
- Legal services
- Insurance
- Medical aesthetics and med spas
- Dental practices
- Local and professional service businesses
